verdict.rationale: Snyk's core scanning platform is a hosted service. The only self-hosted pieces in the evidence are Broker and agent components, which connect private networks to that service, and a local CLI and MCP server that use Snyk. These are adjacent connectors, not a self-hostable core product, and no evidence shows an on-prem deployment of the platform itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Run your Broker deployment on your container engine
The Snyk Broker Container Registry Agent enables you to connect with network-restricted container registries so you can scan these registries using the Snyk service.
